items.quote: DTA (DSC404C, Netzsch, Germany) was used to measure phase transition temperatures.
The sample was examined by XRD to verify if it is Ti5 Ge3 single phase after the high temperature reaction synthesis.

The measurement of enthalpy of formation for Ti5 Ge3 was performed using the Kleppa-type HTRC with the calorimeter temperature set at 1373 ± 2 K. The experiment was conducted under the protection of argon atmosphere.
A Pt-Pt/Rh thermocouple was used. In the examined temperature range, the accuracy of the temperature measurement was estimated to be ±2 K.

Pure Ge pieces (purity 99.9 wt.%) and Ti pieces (purity 99.9 wt.%) were arc-melted in an arc melting furnace (WKDHL-1, Opto-electronics Co. Ltd., Beijing, China) under high purity argon atmosphere using a non-consumable W electrode. The buttons were re-melted four times to improve their homogeneities.
